title: Messi's Assists vs Ronaldo's Goals
claim: Assists are for waiters: goals win games, so Ronaldo's goals beat Messi's record assists.
comment_ron: Nobody remembers who passed. Ronaldo has the most international goals ever.
comment_leo: Most assists in history AND two goals in a World Cup final. Ronaldo never passed in his life.
facts: Messi holds the record for most assists in history (official matches)
Ronaldo has more career goals than Messi
Ronaldo holds the men's record for international goals
Messi scored twice in the 2022 World Cup final, one a penalty
Ronaldo scored in the 2008, 2014 (penalty) and 2017 Champions League finals
